description: Start the platform sign-in for one of your accounts and return `authorizeUrl`. Give that link to the user to open in a browser SIGNED IN TO VIBEVO AS THIS ACCOUNT OWNER — the callback is bound to that session and rejects anyone else. The link expires after `expiresIn` seconds. After consent the account becomes verified and its statistics refresh on their own; call vibevo_list_social_accounts to confirm. Supported: YouTube, Instagram, TikTok (availability depends on the account rollout). Requires the write scope + PUBLIC_API_WRITE.

id.description: Your social account id (from the list tool).
